description: Find who a company teams with on federal contracts — the primes it subcontracts for and the subcontractors under it. Built from prime-reported subcontract records (USAspending/FSRS): real reported relationships, not guesses. Use it before a recompete to map an incumbent's bench, or to find primes a subcontractor already works with. Requires a BidCatch intel key.

company.description: Company name, e.g. 'Booz Allen Hamilton' — resolved to the strongest match

role.description: prime = only partners they sub FOR; sub = only subs UNDER them; omit for both

uei.description: SAM.gov Unique Entity ID — the strongest match key

name: find_teaming_partners
